disposition_classes: unsupported by the adapter despite native expressibility
not expressible in the target model
source_structure: one resolved plain consonant; complete declared feature set equals the witness
release_adjudication: A release realized as another segment is represented by a constituent sequence. A release that is a manner or phonation quality remains a value of the release feature. No release value is added solely to absorb a segmental release.
evidence: Pinned BIPA core rows: complete consonant, manner, place and phonation claims; contrasts p/b and t/d.
Native strict constructors: one bare constituent, no modifiers, approach, junctures or prosody; independent manner/place/voiced expectations.
Native defaults remain native claims; these witnesses establish no reverse rule.
Pinned BIPA release declarations use ̚, ˡ, ᵊ and ⁿ for the four feature-valued releases; the same marks strictly read as native release values no-audible, lateral, schwa and nasal.
Strict native witnesses t͡s, d͡r and d͡ʁ retain two constituents with fricative, trill and uvular-fricative release material respectively.
Resolver witnesses aː, aˑ, aːː, ă, tː, tˑ and tːː assert the reviewed duration values; native feature_values preserves their distinct written length values.
The strict native reader constructs ⁿd with approach=nasal on its one constituent.
enhancements.reason: Existing native approach expresses the reviewed nasal-approach witness; missing correspondence support is not a missing feature.
enhancements.consequence: Retain the source-only claim until a reviewed correspondence exists; do not infer a timed nasal child.

evidence: The pinned BIPA resolver equates untied and superscript-sibilant affricate spellings while the strict native reader constructs adjacency, fused tie and sequential tie as distinct structures.
enhancements.reason: The source does not retain enough evidence to choose among native adjacency and the two native tie senses.
enhancements.consequence: No unconditional inverse or new feature recovers erased tie evidence.
enhancements.deciding_evidence: An explicit lane F projection convention, with separate source and inferred house claims, would decide which native structure to construct.

evidence: Pinned BIPA ¹³¹ separates from-low, via-mid, to-low and contour claims; the strict native reader constructs a hosted three-level pitch sequence and derives its contour.

native_construction_attempts.distinction: hosted bottom-mid-bottom tone sequence and rising-falling contour

enhancements.reason: The native pitch model is expressive, but source tone association requires an explicit host relation rather than strict segment parsing alone.
enhancements.consequence: Retain or refuse the source tone pending profile binding; never fabricate a nucleus or silence.
enhancements.deciding_evidence: A bound source profile with caller-supplied tone-host links and literal start, middle, end and contour projection tests would decide the adapter mapping.

evidence: The current house reader drops ˢ, ʳ, ʶ and ᵐ with its lossy warning, and the strict reader rejects them as unknown notation; it already constructs t͡s, d͡r and d͡ʁ and reads tⁿ as release=nasal.
enhancements.reason: K3 accepts all four BIPA superscript spellings into the house parser, not only a BIPA reader.
enhancements.consequence: Lane H owns parser admission and tests; A3 makes no parser or ipa.xml change.

evidence: The pinned BIPA resolver canonicalizes tᵐ to tⁿ with the same with-nasal-release claim, while the strict house reader currently rejects tᵐ and reads tⁿ as release=nasal.

native_construction_attempts.distinction: bilabial rather than generic nasal release

enhancements.reason: K4 accepts a new release=bilabial-nasal value for ᵐ; release=nasal remains the value for ⁿ, and no release-place dimension is added.
enhancements.consequence: Lane H owns the bounded native value, parser behavior and tests; CLTS projection cannot recover the distinction after BIPA collapse.

evidence: Pinned BIPA Ø asserts all three unspecified values; the house has no such manner, place or voice values, and its strict reader rejects Ø.

native_construction_attempts.distinction: explicitly unspecified manner, place and voice rather than absent claims

enhancements.reason: The evidence establishes an explicit-source distinction and a native model gap, but not whether those placeholders should enter the computational house inventory.
enhancements.consequence: Preserve or refuse the source claims; do not turn explicit unspecified values into native defaults, absence or silence.
enhancements.deciding_evidence: The source-preserving Form contract and consumer behavior for explicit unknown values must show a need for computational house values rather than source-only retention.

evidence: Pinned BIPA declares s̫ as a whistled-sibilant fricative; the house airstream inventory has no whistled value and its strict reader rejects the whistling mark.
enhancements.reason: The source establishes a distinction, but does not decide whether the house should model it as airstream, channel, a modifier or another articulatory property.
enhancements.consequence: Retain the source-only claim and do not map it to ordinary sibilance.
enhancements.deciding_evidence: A phonetic model proposal must locate the distinction in the house feature geometry and specify constructor, rendering and distance behavior.
